approach.title: Research
approach.description: Understand the brand, audience and context. Review what already exists and identify the problem worth solving.

approach.title: Direction
approach.description: Turn research into a clear visual position, defining the concept, mood, language and boundaries of the work.

approach.title: System
approach.description: Bring typography, layout, imagery, colour and interface into one coherent visual language.

approach.title: Application
approach.description: Test the system across real formats — web, print, packaging and digital interfaces — then refine it through use.

approach.title: Delivery
approach.description: Organise the final design, guidelines and reusable assets so the system can continue to work after the project ends.

roadmap.title: The studio begins to take shape
roadmap.description: The studio began to take shape through early experiments in identity, web and visual design.

roadmap.title: From individual pieces to visual systems
roadmap.description: The practice moved beyond isolated outputs toward systems connecting typography, layout, imagery, interfaces and applications.

roadmap.title: The scope of design expands
roadmap.description: The scope expanded across identity, digital interfaces, editorial design and visual communication.

roadmap.title: Project selected at national level
roadmap.description: Contributed to the project's visual identity, interface and overall design language. The project was subsequently selected as a national-level project.

roadmap.title: MĒTIS becomes the studio name
roadmap.description: The studio adopted the name MĒTIS, from the ancient Greek μῆτις — intelligence, skill and judgement.
